features.name: Favored Enemy 1
features.summary: Choose a creature type and gain +2 on key skills, attacks, and damage against it.

features.name: Track
features.summary: Add half Ranger level, minimum +1, to Survival checks made to follow tracks.

features.name: Wild Empathy
features.summary: Influence animals using Ranger level plus Charisma modifier.

features.name: Combat Style
features.summary: Choose Archery or Two-Weapon Combat; later style feats ignore normal prerequisites.

features.name: Combat Style Feat 1
features.summary: Choose a feat from the selected combat style without meeting its normal prerequisites.

features.name: Endurance
features.summary: Gain Endurance as a bonus feat.

features.name: Favored Terrain 1
features.summary: Choose a terrain and gain +2 initiative and relevant skill bonuses there.

features.name: Hunter's Bond
features.summary: Bond with companions or an animal companion.

features.name: Divine Spellcasting
features.summary: Prepare Ranger spells using Wisdom; caster level equals Ranger level minus 3.

features.name: Favored Enemy 2
features.summary: Choose another favored enemy and increase one favored-enemy bonus by +2.

features.name: Combat Style Feat 2
features.summary: Choose another feat from the selected combat style, with expanded options.

features.name: Woodland Stride
features.summary: Move through natural undergrowth at normal speed without harm.

features.name: Swift Tracker
features.summary: Track at normal speed without the usual penalty.

features.name: Favored Terrain 2
features.summary: Choose another terrain and increase one favored-terrain bonus by +2.

features.name: Evasion
features.summary: Take no damage on a successful Reflex save against effects that allow half damage.

features.name: Favored Enemy 3
features.summary: Choose another favored enemy and increase one favored-enemy bonus by +2.

features.name: Combat Style Feat 3
features.summary: Choose another feat from the selected combat style, with advanced options.

features.name: Quarry
features.summary: Designate a favored enemy as quarry for tracking, attack, and critical-confirmation benefits.

features.name: Camouflage
features.summary: Use Stealth in favored terrain without cover or concealment.

features.name: Favored Terrain 3
features.summary: Choose another terrain and increase one favored-terrain bonus by +2.

features.name: Combat Style Feat 4
features.summary: Choose another feat from the selected combat style.

features.name: Favored Enemy 4
features.summary: Choose another favored enemy and increase one favored-enemy bonus by +2.

features.name: Improved Evasion
features.summary: Take half damage even on a failed Reflex save against effects that allow half damage.

features.name: Hide in Plain Sight
features.summary: Use Stealth while observed in favored terrain.

features.name: Favored Terrain 4
features.summary: Choose another terrain and increase one favored-terrain bonus by +2.

features.name: Combat Style Feat 5
features.summary: Choose a fifth feat from the selected combat style.

features.name: Improved Quarry
features.summary: Select quarry faster, track it perfectly, and gain +4 on attacks.

features.name: Favored Enemy 5
features.summary: Choose a fifth favored enemy and increase one favored-enemy bonus by +2.

features.name: Master Hunter
features.summary: Track at full speed and make a lethal or incapacitating attack against favored enemies.
features.uses: once per day per favored enemy type
